outcome.reason: Comment authorized. A signed approval covers this exact pull request, and a second signed approval covers this exact comment text.
Comment rejected because a signed approval does not cover both this pull request and this exact comment text.

description: Authorizes one comment on a GitHub pull request. Two signed approvals from trusted people are required: one covers the exact pull request (the target), and one covers the exact comment text (the body). Nothing else authorizes the comment.
